title: Rust tunnel_auth authorize_decapsulation uses first-match instead of Python's longest-prefix selection (P-R divergence)
description: Codereview finding on aqyw (correctness pass; pre-existing divergence, NOT introduced by the aqyw diff). python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py:545-548 selects the matching authorization with max(candidates, key=prefixlen) (longest-prefix wins) and THEN checks expiry; rust/lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs authorize_decapsulation takes the FIRST matching slot in array order (break at first match, ~line 384-401), returning Expired if that candidate is expired even when a different (longer-prefix) live candidate would authorize. Deny-only divergence: Rust denies where Python permits. Fix: collect all matches, select longest prefix_len (tie-break deterministically, e.g. lexicographic route_hash), then apply the expiry check to the selected candidate; mirror Python's ordering exactly. Add a unit test with two overlapping-prefix claims where the shorter prefix entry is expired and the longer is live.
